author: LA50SHOOTER
notes_extra: Jammed 0.005 into the lands. He wrote a "Standard" 6 BR.

author: powderbrake
notes_extra: 88 gr Berger flat based varmint, .38 G1 bc. His 105 at 30 gr of Varget is a different bullet.

author: effendude
notes_extra: Berger 88 grain FB Varmint. He also loaded the 87 grain V-Max with the same charge. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 6XC.

author: powderbrake
notes_extra: 88 gr Bergers (#24323), lot D090. 1:8 Krieger. Wheeler touch was 1.809 and he seated at 1.811, which is not COAL. .003 into the lands.

author: gunsandgunsmithing
notes_extra: 10 twist. The last he shot of the 88s was 30.8 gr of 8208. He wrote that they were good.

author: powderbrake
notes_extra: 88 gr Berger High BC Flat Base Varmint. Seated .006 to .009 into the lands. No-turn cases. 15 ES and 5.7 SD. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 6 BR.

author: rickhirsch
notes_extra: He wrote 31.grs. Shot into the ones at 100 yards. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 6 BR.

author: Lefty Trigger
notes_extra: OCW result. ES 7 and SD 3.6. He ran them .010 off, which is not COAL. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 6 BR.

author: Bill Norris
notes_extra: New unfired Lapua, kissing the lands. 1-8 twist. 3/8 inch 5 shot group at 100 yards. He said the load was safe in his rifle with no signs of pressure. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 6 BR.

author: Texas10
notes_extra: Backed off .020 from hard jam. Initial tests indicated a sweet spot. Later windy tests did not confirm it. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 6 BR.

author: Lefty Trigger
notes_extra: 5 shot group of 1 1/8 at 200 yards. He said the 30.2 load is Berger's max in the book. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 6 BR.

author: LA50SHOOTER
notes_extra: 88 gr Berger High BC Varmint FB. 29 in Bartlein 5R, 7.75 twist. He wrote a .268 neck straight 6 BR.
